class.name: BoneClothCollision3D
class.brief_description: A base class of the collisions that interact with [BoneClothSimulator3D].
class.description: A collision has an effect only as a child of [BoneClothSimulator3D]. Every joint of the simulator, and every link between its chains, is pushed out of each child collision in the order of the scene tree. If [member bone] is set, the collision follows the bone's pose plus [member position_offset] and [member rotation_offset], before the simulator's steps each frame. Moving or rotating it, with the editor's tools or by setting its transform, stores the new place in the offsets. A scale is dropped: the size of a shape is its own properties, which the handles in the 3D editor drag. Without a bone, the collision stays where it is placed.

method.name: get_skeleton
method.description: Returns the [Skeleton3D] of the parent [BoneClothSimulator3D], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

members.member: The index of the attached bone. [code]-1[/code] is no bone.
The name of the attached bone. A name the skeleton does not have prints a warning and attaches no bone.
The offset of the position from the [member bone] pose position, along the bone's axes.
The offset of the rotation from the [member bone] pose rotation.
